title: Shake Shack’s Holiday Shakes Are Back! Featuring A New Shake with Ferrero Rocher
body_markdown:
The holiday season is officially here, and we’re serving up festivity in every sip!


## **What is on the Shake Shack holiday shake menu?**


At the heart of this year’s holiday lineup is an indulgent creation: the Hazelnut Chocolate Shake paired with a Ferrero Rocher® chocolate square. Poured into a crackable dark chocolate shell and finished with premium toppings, it’s our most luxurious seasonal shake yet.


Rounding out our festive trio is the return of the fan-favorite Christmas Cookie Shake and the debut of the Butterscotch Crème Brûlée Shake.


## **Shake Shack’s Holiday Shake Offerings**


### **Hazelnut Chocolate Shake Paired with a Ferrero Rocher® chocolate square**


Vanilla frozen custard hand-spun with chocolate hazelnut spread poured into a crackable dark chocolate shell, topped with whipped cream, chopped hazelnuts, crunchy wafer flakes, and a Ferrero Rocher® chocolate square for the ultimate holiday indulgence.


### **Christmas Cookie Shake**


Sugar cookie frozen custard topped with whipped cream and holiday sprinkles.


### **Butterscotch Crème Brûlée Shake**


Butterscotch crème brûlée frozen custard topped with whipped cream and honeycomb pieces.


### **When can you get Shake Shacks holiday shake menu?**


These holiday sips are available for a limited time only. Skip the wait by ordering ahead on the Shack App or at shakeshack.com!
